rootWorkingTreeScope: Root has uncommitted parallel integration; exact baseline hashes below, not HEAD alone, identify this patch base.
behavior: OpenCode rejection marks the current prompt and continues in the same owned session/turn with exactly the pinned no-retry text, after pending human decisions settle.
Continuation input is one text block only; original user input, history/context, denied command and media are never automatically resent.
After terminal prompt response, nonterminal execute tools wait for further tool updates. The one-second quiet window restarts on tool activity; completed/failed states stop waiting.
A stale command is marked failed, preserving its existing output; at most three pinned no-retry recovery prompts follow.
An early terminal prompt response does not discard outstanding approvals/questions, including existing MCP forms.
Cancellation, shutdown, replacement, output-bound failure and observer deletion prevent queued obsolete continuation/completion.
Nested terminal notification during stale sweep is respected; current per-key status and pending-decision state are rechecked before each stale transition.
intentionalNativeBounds: At most eight total continuation prompts (including denials and stale recoveries); another attempt fails explicitly. Pinned rejection loop itself has no matching count cap.

One shared active-time budget uses existing promptTimeoutMs (100..600000 ms) for prompt/settlement/continuations. Native/MCP human waits pause this budget. The pinned runtime has no equivalent whole-turn active-time cap.
Existing 4 MiB aggregate output/20000 event and process/request limits remain unchanged.
beforeReproductions: Original production adapter: denial stops after first prompt, late command output lost, early prompt completion discards pending approval (before:2 pass/3 fail).
First staged settlement sweep: nested completed command overwritten as failed (peer-before:2 pass/1 fail); fixed by current-state revalidation and actual-stale accounting.
testMethod: Private native Qt process fixtures, actual AgentEngine, and existing compatibility tests linked to frozen root archives plus exact privately compiled class/allocator/moc overrides. No shared build/source changes, UI, accounts, credentials, network or model calls. Root integration/full gate remains required.
compatibilityFixtureChange: AcpFixture recognizes only the exact pinned single-text denial continuation and emits ACP_CONTINUED; its original approval scenario remains unchanged. Previously the fake process replayed its initial permission request forever for every prompt.
integrationNotes: Patch changes only AcpHarnessSession.{h,cpp}, the existing fake ACP fixture, and adds the new fixture/test. Do not copy the private unchanged AgentEngineAcp.cpp override into production.
Recompile all allocations/consumers after class layout change. The private Engine override exists only for ABI-safe linking to frozen archives.
History-continuity patch is independent (Engine/proof), and remains separately frozen.
Attachment owner modifies ACP input/media validation/prompt; these response/settlement/lifecycle hunks should merge narrowly. Do not replace a newer full class from this private copy.
limits: No live OpenCode validation for this change; deterministic ACP behavior establishes only covered scenarios.
The adapter does not execute or auto-approve a denied action; an external model may request a new action, which still follows ordinary explicit approval and loop bounds.
Late results arriving after the quiet-window recovery/whole-turn completion are outside retained active-turn ownership; this does not promise capture of arbitrarily delayed external output.
Native direct Claude/Codex settlement behavior is unchanged and not claimed equivalent by this slice.
